messages:
ana-partners: Heads-up — big SI + HW partner asking for a marketplace private-offer that smooths commit over 18 months. want to propose a "concierge" onboarding credit + staggered renewals to lower churn risk. anyone have a quick checklist for what we need to lock before we promise co-announce timing? :thinking:

marta-sales: Definitely need finance signoff on the credit amortization and a clear SKU for reserved capacity. also need channel/kickback rules for the SI. quick Q: is this a pure marketplace private offer or a bundled private offer + HW rebate?

ana-partners: it's bundled — customer wants the private offer on marketplace + an HW rebate (partner-managed). they want a joint announce in Q3 and prefer revenue recognition over time so the credit spreads across quarters.

sam-engineering: From infra side, confirm we can guarantee the reserved-capacity SKU for the 18mo window. if they require burst guarantees we may need to carve a dedicated pool. can you share expected p95 token throughput?

ana-partners: customer estimate: p95 ~ 220 concurrent sessions, avg 1.2k tokens/session peak. put placeholder numbers in proposal for now.

marta-sales: FYI finance will want to model AR impact. we can template an amortized credit: "onboard-credit" equal to X% of committed spend, paid as marketplace credit over first 6 mo. renewal hinge: if they hit 80% of commit in months 7-12 we reduce next-year discount by 2 points. keeps them accountable.

rajesh-legal: Need to bake in renewal triggers and clawback. two asks: 1) define clear measurement windows and who reports usage (marketplace metering vs partner reporting), 2) include a clause that HW rebate is independent and not counted against our onboarding credit unless explicitly reconciled. will prep suggested clause.

liz-gpmkt: On the announcement side, marketing needs 6 weeks lead for joint press + co-branded assets. Also want to avoid naming the HW rebate specifics in press — we can say "joint go-to-market incentives". Can the commit cadence support a single public launch date, or should we do a staged announce (announcement + later usage milestone update)?

marta-sales: Staged announce sounds safer. public launch at contract sign, then a "usage milestone" case study at month 6 if they hit early adoption. keeps momentum for renewals.

sam-engineering: One caveat: if we do staggered rollout and they route traffic between hosted + dedicated, we need to document routing policy in the offer. otherwise their burst might failover to a non-dedicated pool and break latency SLOs. add a short routing appendix: preferred region, fallback tier, model variants allowed.

ana-partners: good point. i'll add a routing appendix and ask client to accept the model-variant fallback list.

rajesh-legal: also propose a 12-month audit right for us to validate usage and ensure credits/clawbacks are enforceable. without that finance will push back.

marta-sales: Agree. finance check: we should cap the onboarding credit at 25% of first-year committed spend and amortize over Q1-Q2. That limit makes the offer more sellable internally.

liz-gpmkt: For co-marketing budget, can we require a $50k MDF contribution from the SI/hw partner to unlock the joint PR? makes them invest in launch.

ana-partners: i'll test that ask.

sam-engineering: Technical checklist to include in the proposal (copyable):
```
- Reserved SKU name and capacity commitment
- Model variants allowed (list + quantization/latency tradeoffs)
- Routing policy: primary region, fallback region, and fallback model tier
- Burst policy and dedicated pool sizing guidance
- Telemetry hooks and tagging schema for usage attribution
```

marta-sales: Sales playbook note: include a one-pager "concierge onboarding flow" that explains credit vesting, success milestones, and renewal uplift language. helps AEs and SI PMs.

rajesh-legal: I'll draft the renewal/clawback language and the audit clause today. will ping when ready.

liz-gpmkt: Marketing timeline request: Draft press kit by 6/15, partner review by 6/22, final signoff 7/1. if we miss that, we push public announce to next quarter.

ana-partners: Thanks all — next steps for me: 1) draft the bundled private-offer term sheet with amortized onboarding credit cap at 25%, 2) include routing appendix + technical checklist, 3) coordinate MDF ask with SI partner, 4) loop in finance for AR model. I'll drop the draft in this thread by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: created doc branch `partners/3161234567-concierge-offer-draft` on repo partners/offers.

marta-sales: great, will review once branch is up. :eyes:
